run_googletest_output_test: run the googletest output test to verify Google Test text output matches the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a golden file by running googletest-output-test.py with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize Google Test program output by removing locations, stack traces, and time info
remove_stack_trace_details: remove stack trace details from Google Test output replacing them with omitted placeholder
remove_matching_tests: remove output of specified tests from Google Test program output using a regex pattern
